brief:
The Palestinian Prisoner's Society reported that Israeli prisons have carried out dozens of repression raids against Palestinian detainees since October 7, the Palestine News Network said. The raids involved firing rubber-coated bullets at detainees' limbs and deploying tear gas, according to the society's account.

The organization documented systematic use of force against Palestinians held in Israeli custody in the period following the October 7 events and subsequent days.
